title: cxr-selective-trust: reproducibility audit tooling and frozen-prediction artifacts for medical vision-language model evaluation
description:
Audit tooling and frozen-prediction artifacts for measuring medical vision-language models (VLMs). The repository contains two manuscripts, the protocols and configs that produced them, and cxr-audit, a CPU-only command-line tool that recomputes the denominator of a prediction file (rows, unique keys, duplicate rows/groups, parse rate), measures response collapse and P1 change on shifted inputs, and compares selective-prediction signals (status-aware confidence, Bernoulli entropy, probability margin) by AUROC and coverage at fixed risk budgets.

No model weights, medical images or patient data are redistributed. Code, manifests and derived tables are MIT-licensed; the original dataset and model licences continue to apply. The manuscripts are “Responsiveness Before Reliance: Four Reversals in Measuring Medical Vision-Language Models” and “Auditing the Denominator: Coverage Census and Fault-Tested Durability for Medical VLM Benchmarks”.

creators.name: Huang, Koshun
creators.affiliation: School of Medical Imaging, North Sichuan Medical College, Nanchong, Sichuan, China

notes: Model weights (about 164 GB) and medical images are not included. The frozen predictions and derived tables are released for research use under the licences of the source datasets.
